title: Distinctive OfferPath sign-in branding
changes: Place a larger decorated OfferPath mark and wordmark above the sign-in panel, with responsive sizing and theme-aware lighting.

title: Content-only workspace scrolling
changes: Keep the workspace header and banner outside the main page scrollbar while preserving dedicated calendar and sourcing scroll areas.

title: Simplified bidder week controls
changes: Remove visible Week of and Bidder labels while preserving accessible control names.

title: Consistent sourcing toolbar surface
changes: Use one continuous theme-aware background across date navigation and editing controls.

title: Bottom-aligned triage controls
changes: Align mail-view tabs and header controls to the bottom of the triage heading block.

title: Unified bidder totals and week filters
changes: Place Today, weekly estimated confirmations, and recorded payments beside right-aligned week and bidder controls in a single compact desktop row.

title: Unified job sourcing command bar
changes: Combine date navigation and editing tools in one compact desktop row while retaining accessible controls on smaller screens.

title: Balanced triage header spacing
changes: Group mail tabs beside the heading and align filters, counts, and Undo in a compact continuous header.

title: Single-row triage navigation
changes: Center mail-view tabs, filters, and message count beside the triage heading on wide screens, with responsive wrapping on smaller screens.

title: Sign-in availability and pending request safeguards
changes: Prevent sign-in until a valid enabled account is selected and its directory is available.
Lock account and password controls during sign-in to avoid conflicting submissions.

title: Compact workspace and admin account selection
changes: Reduced heading sizes, toolbar spacing, and summary card height across the workspace.
Choose an enabled admin username from a sign-in selector, with password authentication preserved.
Simplified sign-in and moved workbook creation into a collapsible section.

title: Fixed job sourcing column headers
changes: Replaced spreadsheet letters and the duplicate header row with fixed Company, Role, Job link and Check headings, and removed the Insert/edit menu while preserving job editing, paste and CSV workflows.

title: Modern Dashboard activity chart
changes: Redesigned the main Dashboard chart with rounded gradient stacks, accurate total badges, a subtle trend overlay, polished tooltips and legend, and responsive range controls.

title: Reliable workspace and page recovery
changes: Fixed owner Settings recovery when bootstrap fails and added a way to clear invalid Dashboard filters.
Fixed overlapping admin suspension and re-enabling that could leave an enabled workspace stopped.

title: Clear gateway error recovery
changes: Replaced raw proxy HTML and malformed responses with concise connection errors, preserved API validation messages and CSV downloads, and verified Dashboard recovery without automatically retrying writes.

title: Professional workspace design
changes: Refined the entire interface with calm slate and white surfaces, clearer typography, neutral dividers, cohesive cards, controls, tables, dialogs, and responsive layouts.
Improved visual hierarchy across dashboards, sourcing, calendars, accounts, bidder management, Settings, and admin workspaces while preserving existing actions and access permissions.

title: More space for sidebar navigation
changes: Removed the sidebar's privacy card and repeated application/account footer to give navigation more room.

title: Refined sidebar selection
changes: Refined sidebar navigation with soft selected surfaces, a slim accent rail, inset icon emphasis, quieter badges, and distinct hover and keyboard-focus states in both themes.

title: Clearer sidebar navigation icons
changes: Replaced repeated and mismatched sidebar icons with workflow, briefcase, mailbox, settings gear, and admin shield symbols.

title: Read-only bidder job sourcing
changes: Bidders can browse their own saved sourcing workbook by date and account tab, search their jobs, and copy links or a day's rows without editing or refreshing data.

title: Read-only bidder team accounts
changes: Added Admin and Bidder sign-in options with workspace-qualified bidder names and admin-managed passwords.
Bidders can view their admin's whole team on Dashboard and Bidder management, with server-enforced read-only access and revocable sessions.

title: Refined OfferPath identity
changes: Refined the OfferPath icon with a sculpted ascending-path mark, a navy tile, and a cyan-to-blue finish across the app and browser tab.

title: Consistent light and dark themes
changes: Improved shared scrollbars, keyboard focus, form controls, selection colors, and theme-specific chart contrast.
Fixed light-mode calendar colors and date-input styling while preserving each account's calendar color identity.

title: Clearer version history
changes: Improved release history with colored category dots, readable labels, clearer release cards, and a latest-version highlight.

title: OfferPath workspace release
changes: Isolated admin workspaces with owner-managed accounts and shared settings.
AI-assisted email drafts for follow-ups, availability, and rescheduling, with manual review and sending.
Unified interview calendars and interview-process follow-up actions.
Bidder management with weekly confirmation estimates, editable payments, wallet information, and copyable payment reports.
Selected-week refresh and full rebuild of automatic application matches.
Job sourcing filters for duplicate links and blocked companies.
Faster gateway connections, cached application assets, and optimized weekly reconciliation.
Visible application version and update history. Version tracking begins with this release.
